title: Listen and Choose a Response — Late Night Study

questions.stem: Aren't you tired after studying all night?

options.A: I'm tired of the same food every day.
options.B: I studied in the library last night.
options.C: No, I'm exhausted and need to sleep.
options.D: A little, but the exam is in an hour.

questions.explanation: Admitting tiredness and giving a reason to keep going fits; the 'No' option contradicts itself.
